claims.text: The Rio Negro and the Solimões meet near Manaus, Brazil.
Belém, Macapá and Porto Velho are not where the Rio Negro meets the Solimões.
The Rio Negro and the Solimões differ in temperature, speed and acidity.
The waters of the Rio Negro and the Solimões flow side by side for several kilometres before mixing.
